evidence: The structural, optical and electrical properties of these films have been investigated using X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray reflectometry (XRR), atomic force microscopy (AFM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), spectroscopic ellipsometry, and Hall effect measurements. XRR data and azimuthal scans were recorded using a NaI scintillometer.
